performance.verdict: Campaigns went dark Aug 6; GHL pipeline shows zero opps despite 45 leads.

findings.text: All paid spend dropped to $0 from Aug 6 onward — 12 consecutive zero-spend days confirmed in series; zero leads since Aug 6.
GHL shows 33 contacts but 0 opportunities created and 0 appointments from 45 leads — intake pipeline is not converting leads to opps at all.
3-day signal (Aug 15–17): spend $0, leads 0, sc_clicks avg 3.3 vs prior 3-day avg 21.7 — organic search also declining sharply as paid halo disappears.
GBP actions down -23.4% (7d delta) and ig_reach collapsed -98.76% — organic presence decaying in parallel with paid shutdown, compounding lead loss.
GA4 sessions spiked to 206 on Aug 13 while spend was $0 — directional anomaly only (known double-count property issue); not a real traffic event.

suggestions.text: Immediately identify why Meta campaigns paused Aug 6 — billing, policy, or budget exhaustion — and restore spend at prior $69/day rate.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta spend has been $0 for 12 consecutive days since Aug 6, halting all 45-lead-per-28-day flow. Diagnose cause (billing hold, policy flag, or budget cap hit) and restore campaigns at the last confirmed daily rate of ~$69/day. Success is confirmed when spend resumes and at least 1 lead is recorded within 48 hours of reactivation. Resolve by Aug 20.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL intake: 33 contacts, 0 opportunities created — find where leads are entering but not converting to opps and fix the pipeline stage mapping.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 33 contacts from the 28-day window but 0 opportunities created and 0 appointments — leads are arriving but not progressing, which is an intake configuration issue, not an ads problem. Review the contact-to-opportunity automation or manual workflow in GHL to identify the broken handoff. Success is confirmed when new leads from resumed Meta campaigns begin generating opportunities within the same week. Complete audit by Aug 21.

suggestions.text: Watch sc_clicks 3-day average after Meta reactivation; if paid halo does not recover to 15+ clicks/day by Aug 25, flag for organic search review.
suggestions.monday_update: Search clicks averaged 21.7/day in the 3 days before paid shutdown and have since dropped to a 3-day average of 3.3 — consistent with paid halo loss. Once Meta campaigns are restored (S1), monitor sc_clicks daily. If the 3-day average does not return to at least 15 clicks/day by Aug 25, escalate to Sohib for an organic or SEO review. Re-check Aug 25.
